title: Visually Tuned
description: This project is made to make Vanilla Minecraft look prettier, I hope you enjoy it!
body:
Have you ever thought Minecraft looks a tiny bit bland? Well I have JUST the modpack for you! Visually Tuned aims to take Vanilla Minecraft, and make it look prettier than it's ever been with as few mods as possible! With a combination of recource packs, I feel that I've made Minecraft look near PERFECT.

Trust ME, with your Minecraft visuals.
